about: E54's reshape cut (the plan's P1, F5; the owner's Q-E54-5, the default): cleanup.mjs's veiled `whisperToOwner`, `findRemnantToken`, the reshape road (`askTransform` .. `askTransformChange`) and the clean-up receipt store (`RECEIPT_FIELDS` .. `recreationDataFor`) into cleanup-reshape.mjs; cleanup.mjs imports `whisperToOwner` back. Run as windows.json's about says, with this manifest.

header: The reshape road (E54, the plan's P1): the killer's change asked (`askTransform`, `askTransformChange`), the words
bounded (`plainText`), the reshape proposed and ruled on by a GM (`proposeReshape`, `claimRuling`, `applyReshapeRuling`,
`declineReshapeRuling`, `ruleReshape`), the Remnant's token found (`findRemnantToken`), the veiled whisper to the
killer (`whisperToOwner`), and the clean-up receipt store the Reroll's undo reads too (`RECEIPT_FIELDS`, `keepAttempt`,
`forgetAttempt`, `keepAttemptFact`, `recreationDataFor`). Moved out of cleanup.mjs, which re-exports every name it
targets.order: the receipt store first, then findRemnantToken, then the reshape road: a function's cut runs to the next function or `const X = {`, and RECEIPT_FIELDS (an array) ends neither askTransformChange's nor findRemnantToken`s; a tier file reads both (moved-only part cuts, 13.11.2026)
